question.text: Under the SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008, within how many days must an intermediary redress an investor grievance?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that under the SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008, an intermediary is required to redress investor grievances within 45 days. That directly supports option C. The Trap: Option A (21 days) is the timeline that appears in the workbook in the context of grievance handling by depository participants and RTAs/participants, and is also reflected in a chapter sample question for RTAs. Candidates who recall the 21-day figure from that context can mistakenly apply it to the Intermediaries Regulations, but the two timelines come from different rule sets. Options B and D (30 and 60 days) are not the figure prescribed by the Intermediaries Regulations. Note: The 45-day timeline comes specifically from the SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008, while the 21-calendar-day figure shown in the workbook relates to the depository participant/RTA participant context; the two should not be merged.
